name: Rocking Frog Stretch
steps: Kneel on the floor and slide your knees as wide apart as comfortable while resting your forearms flat on the ground in front of you.
Bend both knees to right angles, with ankles behind your knees and the inner edges of your feet on the floor.
Keep your spine neutral and shift your hips slowly backward toward your heels until you feel a deep stretch through your inner thighs.
Hold the stretch while breathing comfortably, then glide forward and continue rocking slowly.
tips: Place a folded towel beneath your knees if the floor feels hard.
Avoid letting your lower back sag downward by keeping your abs lightly engaged.
